Mia is reading a book about science. Mia wrote about the day in the diary. Mia wants to be a doctor in the future. The cat sleeps all day.
Mia hopes to visit Toronto one day. Mia likes snowy days best. They took many photos at the flower market. Buffalo cross the river at dawn.
